Fixed candidates improve comparability but do not eliminate validation overfitting: repeated hyperparameter and checkpoint selection can exploit noise in the same 800 users. Treat the winning validation score as exploratory; reserve the host’s untouched test evaluation for final confirmation. [Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html) explains this selection bias. With 99 negatives, HR@10 measures the pinned sampled-candidate task; improvements need not transfer to full-catalog ranking. Preserve the evaluator and qualify conclusions accordingly. [Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)

For this design, estimate paired uncertainty from per-user hit differences between configurations: resample the same user indices for both models within each category, keep their candidate sets fixed, and recompute the equally weighted four-category macro difference. Report a paired bootstrap interval, category deltas, and discordant hit counts; paired randomization is another option, consistent with [IR significance-testing research](https://ciir-publications.cs.umass.edu/getabs.php?id=885). One changed hit moves category HR by 0.5 percentage points and macro HR by 0.125 points. These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on the fitted models and candidates; they exclude training-seed variability, negative-resampling variability, and adaptive-selection bias.

Practical budget recommendation: prioritize baseline, individual component additions, and the combined model under comparable training resources before assigning high expected impact to the combination. Predeclare comparisons and stopping rules; record all attempted configurations and GPU-seconds, including diagnostics and failures. Use short screening runs cautiously, then confirm finalists at comparable budgets within the 200-epoch ceiling. [Hyperband](https://research.google/pubs/hyperband-a-novel-bandit-based-approach-to-hyperparameter-optimization/) motivates adaptive resource allocation; four concurrent slots reduce elapsed time, not aggregate GPU expenditure against 43,200 GPU-seconds.
